categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: The PR modifies signing logic in src/script/sign.cpp and tests in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py; it does not modify RPC framework machinery, argument parsing, or interfaces.
categories.rationale: Not an RPC change because the category excludes the underlying domain behavior an RPC merely exposes.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes src/script/sign.cpp to correct PSBT MuSig2 key and derivation path population, directly affecting wallet PSBT handling and descriptor processing.
categories.rationale: Fixes an issue where the signer assumed all MuSig2 entries in a SigningProvider applied to the input being signed, leaking unrelated participant pubkeys, derivation paths, and leaf hashes into inputs and outputs where they do not belong (issue #36323). Fixing this metadata leakage is an important correctness and privacy improvement in PSBT handling.
